title: Commercializing the Package Flow: Cross-Sampling Physical Products Through E-Commerce Warehouses
authors: Brian Rongqing Han; Leon Yang Chu; Tianshu Sun; Lixia Wu
eligible_reason: Event-aligned matched design with common relative-time onset and mock data. Sample claimers (if_claimer = 1) are matched to non-claimers within round x shop x subcategory strata; each user is observed in relative weeks -8..60 around the round's sampling event (2_stata_panel_data_construction.do line 40: rel_week = _n - 9) and aggregated to relative months mon = -2..14. Tables 2 and 4 run xtreg y DID_lag1 DID_0 DID_1to3 DID_4to14 i.mon_c if matched == 1, fe vce(cluster new_user_id): user FE plus relative-month FE pooled across rounds, with treated-by-relative-month bins switching on at mon = 0 for every treated user. One cohort in the regression's time index (rounds stacked in relative time, as in mnsc.2022.03266). Section 6 adds DID x score interactions; Table 3 is a cross-section (Poisson, LPM). Package data are mock samples.
design_notes: Stata xtreg fe on matched_data_panel_monthly; Figure 3 weekly event study i.relw_c; Section 6 heterogeneity by customer/item/brand scores (5_stata_analyses_sec6.do) and R (4_r_analyses_sec6.R). Matching: logit propensity score with exact strata (1_stata_matching_and_summary.do).
data_files_note: README: Alibaba data proprietary; 'only mock versions of these datasets are included, with filenames ending in _sample'. Logs from the original data are in logs/orginal_data_log_files/.
screener_notes: No article text or abstract in frame. Mock data only.
